Package neqsim.thermo.util.derivatives

Class DifferentiableFlash

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.util.derivatives.DifferentiableFlash
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class DifferentiableFlash extends Object implements Serializable
Sensitivities of a converged nonreactive, single-phase or vapor-liquid equilibrium.

Flash sensitivities solve the implicit equilibrium Jacobian in log K and vapor fraction. Composition columns use the normalized addition z(h) = (z + h e_j)/(1+h), at fixed total moles. For a tangent direction with sum(dz) = 0, multiplying these columns by dz gives the constrained composition derivative. Pressure derivatives are per bar.

Batched property sensitivities combine the implicit phase-split derivative with centered local EOS/property evaluations, without rerunning a flash. The scalar property API retains full equilibrium finite differences. A batch shares the Jacobian factorization and perturbed states across properties. All calculations use detached snapshots of the supplied current fluid; results are not cached across calls. Reactions, ions, solids, liquid-liquid splits and three-phase states are outside this interface.
